name: v0.39.0
body:
buildx 0.39.0

Welcome to the v0.39.0 release of buildx!



Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at
https://github.com/docker/buildx/issues.

### Contributors

* CrazyMax
* Tõnis Tiigi
* Sebastiaan van Stijn
* Eshan05
* Ihor Urazov
* Kevin Mingtarja
* SaiPisey2

### Notable Changes

- Build history exports from remote builders are now faster by reading blobs in larger chunks. #4137
- Kubernetes builders now use a startup probe to become ready sooner after BuildKit starts. #4124
- The `imagetools create` command now apply untyped annotations to the image index and report unsupported annotation targets instead of silently discarding them. #4091
- Fix Git source policy host matching by normalizing case, internationalized names, trailing dots, and default ports. Policies must match the normalized host. #4171
- Fix builds selecting detected worker platforms over explicitly configured platform assignments. #4133
- Fix trace decoding failures and data loss in build history and Docker Desktop bundle exports. #4156
- Fix empty traces causing a panic and root spans having invalid parent references in Jaeger conversion. #4157
